review.tagline: Finance research agent for backtests, market data and broker connectors
review.summary: Vibe-Trading is a Python agent (FastAPI backend, React 19 web UI, CLI, MCP) for trading research. It pulls market data across many exchanges, runs backtests and factor analysis, and checks figures in generated reports against tool evidence. It also connects to 18 brokers and sends scheduled reports through channels such as Email, Slack, Discord and Feishu.
review.audience: Quant researchers and traders who want an LLM agent for backtesting
strengths: Grounding gate checks each reported figure against session tool evidence and cuts failures
Backtest run cards cite metrics only where saved CSV output agrees
18 broker connectors, several read-only, with paper/live permissions documented
Active: v0.1.16 shipped 116 merged PRs, with near-daily fixes afterward
weaknesses: Narrow domain: finance research only, not a general agent builder
Some broker features are unavailable, e.g. Robinhood options execution
Data quality depends on public sources such as Stooq, which can block requests
Frequent backtest-correctness fixes in the changelog; verify results independently
needs: Needs LLM provider (OpenRouter is the default), Market data sources, Broker APIs (optional)
Models: OpenRouter, Codex, Copilot, custom model endpoints
